title: ReadContract
description: The read-contract object every confidence-emitting surface must return per Calibrated Spine F4/F6. No bare scalar confidence field exists on this type. Contains three distinct confidence axes: calibrated (accuracy, earned), asserted (source-quality), and consequence (severity).

axes.description: Three distinct confidence axes per the calibration architecture.

calibratedConfidence.description: Accuracy axis, earned (commitment #2 governs only this axis).

assertedConfidence.description: Source-quality axis, asserted with provenance on every write.

consequence.description: Severity axis, asserted-audited, derived from code risk classifications.

assembledAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the read-contract was assembled at read time.

modelAttribution.description: Model-attribution stamp from the ledger deposit that sourced this read. Omitted on deterministic / non-model reads.
